# Profile

Sushin Bandha is a Purdue University AI student (B.S. Artificial Intelligence, Minor in CNIT, Expected May 2027). Focus areas: Artificial Intelligence, Product Management, and Project Management. He has hands-on experience in product management, identity & access management (IAM), machine learning, and full-stack AI development.

He is a licensed EMT (NREMT, New Jersey, and Indiana) actively practicing inter-facility patient transport with OnTime Transport in New Jersey, with 56+ hours of additional clinical field experience across hospital ER and pre-hospital EMS environments. He holds the Google AI Professional Certificate (Google / Coursera, completed May 2026) and is a student pilot training for a Private Pilot License.

Key accomplishments include:
- PSEG IAM internship (Summer 2025): Product owner for an enterprise IAM platform — achieved a 99%-defect-free launch with 300+ UAT/SIT test cases, built an IAM scalability business case securing executive approval.
- PSEG Product Intern, Automation & Internal Tools (Summer 2024): Led a 25-intern cross-functional team to launch a company-wide employee onboarding portal; engineered 5 PoC automation tools that secured executive budget approval.
- BASF x The Data Mine wine yield forecasting (Aug–Dec 2024): time-series ML model with 92% sales prediction accuracy (Scikit-learn) and an MLOps pipeline reducing model update time by 97% (2–3 days → ~1–2 hours).
- AI portfolio platform with RAG chatbot: production Next.js + TypeScript site.

He is PSSP Assistant Team Lead for the Purdue University Police Department's Window Program and an Event Supervisor for Purdue Athletics (Big Ten events drawing 60,000+ patrons).

Current projects: Project Manager for TraineeFlightOps (TFO), Purdue CNIT 18200; LostLink, Purdue CS 47500 (HCI); Relay, an independent incident-response platform; AeroLog, Purdue CS 348; and a custom agentic AI chatbot (AiRa).

# Portfolio Website Technical Details

## Overview
Sushin's personal portfolio site is a modern, AI-powered web application built with Next.js 15 (App Router). Version 4 ("Flight Deck") presents it as a flight plan: scrolling climbs through waypoints — Crew Briefing (about), Logbook (experience), Departures board (projects), Ground School (education), Radar (skills), Patches & Stamps (certifications), and Center (contact form). It serves as both a professional showcase and a technical demonstration of AI/ML integration skills.

## Tech Stack
- **Framework:** Next.js 15 with App Router and TypeScript
- **3D:** three.js trainer aircraft in the hero; sky follows the visitor's local time and weather (Open-Meteo)
- **Styling:** Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui component library
- **Animations:** Framer Motion (scroll-driven avatar animation, page transitions)
- **AI Chat:** Google Gemini API via Vercel AI SDK (`@ai-sdk/google`)
- **AI Model:** `gemini-3.1-flash-lite` (configurable via `GEMINI_MODEL` env var)
- **RAG / Knowledge Base:** Custom keyword-based retrieval over pre-computed embeddings stored in `lib/embeddings.json`; source documents in `private/documents/bio/`
- **Deployment:** Vercel (serverless, edge-ready)
- **Database:** Neon (serverless Postgres, used for contact form submissions)
- **Package Manager:** npm

## AI Assistant (AiRa)
- The chat assistant is named **AiRa**, presented as Sushin's First Officer
- Powered by **Google Gemini** — specifically the `gemini-3.1-flash-lite` model
- Uses a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) approach: user queries are matched via keyword scoring against chunked bio documents, and the top relevant chunks are injected into the system prompt
- Rate-limited to 10 requests per hour per session (configurable via `CHAT_RATE_LIMIT` env var)
- Temperature: 0.
